DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma

Your history of smoking and the combination of B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss) with supraclavicular lymphadenopathy and abdominal pain strongly point to this. The patient's suggestion of "No significant finding" is clinically inconsistent with your severe symptoms. Please confirm if you have ever noticed any skin rashes or bleeding gums, and await the results of the CBC, LFTs, and PET-CT I ordered.
